kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw create-security-proxy --proxy-name nat-firewall --region-no cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-uf6b5lyul0x000000 --nat-gateway-id ngw-bp1okz6k7000000 --nat-route-entry-list NextHopType=NatGateway RouteTableId=vtb-2ze1000000 NextHopId=ngw-bp1okz6000000 DestinationCidr=0.0.0.0/0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSecurityProxy

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The name of the NAT firewall. The name can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and cannot start with an underscore
parameters.help_zh: NAT防火墙名称。支持大小写英文字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）、长度为4~50个字符，且不能以下划线开头
parameters.name: proxy_name

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC.

For more information about the regions supported by Cloud Firewall, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.help_zh:
VPC所在的地域ID。

关于云防火墙支持地域的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the automatic vSwitch mode. Valid values:
true: automatic mode
false: manual mode
The default value of VswitchAuto is true. If VswitchAuto is set to true, VswitchCidr is required and must be a valid CIDR block. If VswitchAuto is set to false, VswitchId is required
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用交换机自动模式。取值：
true：自动模式
false：手动模式
VswitchAuto 默认 true。VswitchAuto=true 时 VswitchCidr 必填（且须为合法 CIDR）；VswitchAuto=false 时 VswitchId 必填
parameters.name: vswitch_auto

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is required when the vSwitch is in manual mode
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID。交换机手动模式时必填
parameters.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the default route
fields.name: destination_cidr

fields.help_en: The next hop address of the original NAT gateway
fields.name: next_hop_id

fields.help_en: The network type of the next hop. Valid values: NatGateway
fields.help_zh: 下一跳的网络类型。取值：NatGateway
fields.name: next_hop_type

fields.help_en: The route table that contains the default route of the NAT gateway
fields.help_zh: NAT网关默认路由所在路由表
fields.name: route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The list of routes to be switched for the NAT gateway
parameters.name: nat_route_entry_list

parameters.help_en:
The security protection switch. Valid values:
open: enabled
close: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
安全防护开关。取值：
open：打开
close：关闭
parameters.name: firewall_switch

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable strict mode.

1: Enable strict mode.
0: Disable strict mode
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用严格模式

1：启用严格模式
0：禁用严格模式
parameters.name: strict_mode

parameters.help_en: The CIDR block of the vSwitch. This parameter is required when the vSwitch is in automatic mode
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机的网段。交换机自动模式时必填
parameters.name: vswitch_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The deployment mode of the firewall service. Valid values:

PrimaryStandby: active/standby mode
MultiPrimary: active-active mode
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙服务部署模式。取值：

PrimaryStandby：主备模式
MultiPrimary：双活模式
parameters.name: firewall_service_mode

parameters.help_en: The list of zone IDs used by the firewall service
parameters.help_zh: 防火墙服务使用的可用区 ID 列表
parameters.name: firewall_service_zones

parameters.help_en: The zone of the firewall vSwitch
parameters.name: fw_vswitch_zone_id

ProxyId.description_en: The ID of the NAT firewall
